purpose: Teach: 菊地/平川/滝沢/小柴/志賀/齊藤/岸田/高崎

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「菊地凛子の映画を観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wants to watch a Kikuchi Rinko film.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational opening. Soft tone, almost wistful—passing along something tender about the father-son connection. Warm and observant, like she noticed this detail and wanted to share it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと平川商店街でお買物したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went shopping with Dad at Hirakawa shopping street!
lines.style: Bright, quick energy at the start. Pride in the shared memory tumbles out. Small laugh underneath, genuine delight. The openness of a child who had a good time and wants her to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが滝沢歌舞伎の劇場版を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has been watching the Takizawa Kabuki stage production.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the main idea. Reflective tone, noticing something she finds interesting or touching about his choices. Soft and steady—not performing, just sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小柴博士の物理学の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I read a physics picture book with Dad—Dr. Koshiba's one!
lines.style: Fast-paced excitement, the words tumbling slightly. Clear pride in remembering the author's name. Eager for acknowledgment. The brightness of a six-year-old who learned something and wants to show it off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「志賀直哉の暗夜行路を読了した」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me he'd finished reading Shiga Naoya's 'A Dark Night's Passing.'
lines.style: Quieter admiration underneath. Slight reverence for the literary weight of what she's relaying. Measured, appreciative—the way someone speaks about another's depth when they genuinely respect it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと齊藤茂吉の短歌を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read Saito Mokichi's tanka poems together!
lines.style: Enthusiastic opening burst. Slightly softer on 'together'—that word matters. Quick, genuine happiness. The pride of a child who did something a little grown-up and wants credit for it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが岸田森の俳優論を語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad shared his thoughts about Kishida Mori's theory of acting with me.
lines.style: Reflective, genuinely engaged. The tone of someone listening to something meaningful and wanting to relay it with care. Warm appreciation for the intellectual exchange. Unhurried, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと群馬県高崎の鉄道博物館行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to the railway museum in Takasaki, Gunma!
lines.style: Peak excitement, the words bright and almost tumbling over each other. The geographical detail—saying the full place name—shows he's really proud he remembers. Warm, open joy. The closing has a small breathless quality, like he's offering her something special.
